title: Volume 1 Chapter 4: Candy Coating & Brush Painting 3
content: I focused on the nerves reaching all the way to the tips of my fingers.
Sayori had told me she liked my hands. Even though I still thought they were quite clumsy and inexperienced.
(Please, just this once—move the way I want you to.)
I whispered to my own hands as I moved the brush.
"Whoa, you’ve gone quiet!"
"Hehe, it’s okay. You’re really doing your best, aren’t you?"
"Your expression has changed, hasn’t it?"
"Right? Right? Your eyes are all focused... it’s kind of nice!"
"You look like a craftsman! So cool! Is that what you like about it?"
"N-no, it’s not like that!"
"You don’t have to be shy, you know."
"Stop grinning, Karla!"
The girls were chattering away.
I could hear their words, but I couldn’t grasp their meaning.
What caught my eye was Karla’s fingertips. Just the tiny space of her nails, which accounted for less than one percent of the human body.
Some might wonder what difference it makes to decorate nails. I used to think the same.
But for them, adding color to their fingertips was so important that it could change everything.
(Then I have to help with that.)
I mixed the paint, added glitter, and dipped the brush to apply it to the nails.
There was a tension that I absolutely couldn’t fail.
(It’s strange.)
At the same time, a sense of exhilaration emerged, one that made failure seem impossible.
"I’m done…!"
Wiping the sweat from my forehead, I announced to Karla.
"Ooooh…"
Karla gazed at her four arms and let out a sigh of admiration.
(When was the last time I concentrated this hard…?)
The sounds around me, the words of Karla and Sayori, had faded from my ears. It was proof that I was focused to the utmost limit.
I had experienced this kind of thing a few times while engrossed in making plastic models. I never imagined I could concentrate the same way while doing nails.
Before I knew it, I had come to enjoy painting nails just as much as building models.
"That’s so amazing! It’s exactly what I asked for!"
"Right? Right? Wow, Azuma-kun, that’s some craftsmanship!"
Sayori and Karla cheered as they admired the starry nail design I had completed on their fingertips.
"Looks like you did well…"
"Ah, Azuma-kun? You’re sweating a lot, are you okay?"
Sayori asked with concern.
"I might have over-concentrated a bit…"
It was typical for me to lose sight of my surroundings when I got absorbed in something.
But this time, the task required both speed and precision, so my concentration might have exceeded its limits.
"Hey, take a break. Use this handkerchief."
"Ah, sorry…"
Sayori approached and wiped my sweat. From her handkerchief came a delightful floral scent that I couldn’t quite identify.
"What about a drink… oh right, we can’t eat or drink here. There’s nothing."
"No, it’s fine. I still need to do your nails—"
"What are you saying! You need fluids when you’re sweating! It’s okay to drink outside, right!? There’s a convenience store around the corner. I’ll dash over!"
"W-wait…"
There was no time to stop her.
Sayori, who acted immediately upon thinking of something, quickly left the garage’s office.
"Azuma-kun, just rest!"
As she exited the garage, Sayori called back.
The convenience store was probably a fair distance away. I thought she wouldn’t last if she ran full speed, but by the time I tried to convey that, she was already gone.
"Hehe, you’re quite popular, aren’t you?"
Karla looked at me, propping herself up on her elbows with her four arms.
"I like her… well, maybe, but isn’t she like that with everyone?"
"Hmm, I wonder?"
I was left alone with Karla in the garage.
Before meeting Karla today, I had been worried about what to talk to her about—but after meeting her, a topic had already emerged.
"And if you say you like her, then you must like her too."
"Eh?"
"You seem to really like Sayori."
While I cleaned the plates and brushes I had used for the nails with remover, I wondered if I was right.
Karla had come here, after all, not just to do her nails, but to check what kind of person I was—because of Sayori.
"…Why do you think that?"
"Because since you got here, you’ve been talking about Sayori and me. You haven’t really talked about the nails or how the shoot will go."
Karla’s eyes widened in surprise.
"Did I get found out?"
"More like I noticed… When I looked at you, it seemed that way. Sayori jumps for joy when she gets her nails done and takes tons of photos."
"Ahaha! That’s so like Sayori!"
Karla stood up and stretched.
She intertwined her four arms and reached upwards.
"Sayori has been really happy lately. She’s been struggling with not being able to get her nails done for a long time. I introduced her to our nail artist, but she said it was still difficult."
"I see."
I had heard about her visiting several nail salons.
Naturally, she must have consulted her model friends as well.
"But recently, she’s been talking about wanting to get this kind of nail done, and she’s been brightening up about it… It’s all thanks to you, right?"
"—I think it was just coincidence."
It was just that I happened to have skills in plastic modeling.
By chance, I was able to apply that to Sayori’s nails. That was all there was to it.

"Well, it might be coincidence. But because of that coincidence, Sayori can get her nails done, and she looks really happy… I became really curious about the ‘Azuma-kun’ she talks about. I’d hate to think she’s relying on someone who isn’t serious about it."
"…Is it possible that the lack of a nail artist was just an excuse?"
"No, no, it’s true that I was in trouble without a nail artist, and I really wanted to do a shoot with matching nails with Sayori!"
Karla laughed shyly.
"But when I actually saw ‘Azuma-kun,’ I was relieved to see you seriously responding to Sayori’s request."
"You can’t really tell that from just a little conversation."
"Eh? I can totally tell! Because…"
Karla glanced at her own nails.
"You were so absorbed in doing Sayori’s nails that you didn’t even listen to what we were saying. If you put that much effort into it, the person who asked would be happy too."
"…I’m clumsy. If I don’t concentrate, I can’t do it properly."
"Oh? Being too modest can be annoying, you know?"
"That’s not what I meant—"
"You should be proud that you can do nails that make Sayori happy!"
Karla pointed at my chest with her four arms.
When she put it that way, it made me feel like I really had to stand tall.
"I see that Karla is a good friend."
"Eh? What do you mean?"
Well, it was clear that she was a good friend who went out of her way to check on me and Sayori.
"Anyway, I really like your skills, so I’d like to ask you to keep doing my nails from now on!"
"Sure, sure."
It seemed I had gained another client.
I wondered if Sayori would get mad since she wanted to monopolize my nail services. But, well, Karla said they were best friends, so it should be fine.
After all, Sayori was the one who brought her here.
Sayori was the kind of girl who was liked by everyone, which is probably why she had friends like Karla who watched over her quietly.
"I’m back! What were you two talking about?"
Sayori returned, carrying plastic bags in both hands.
—There were a lot of bottles for just one person.
"Hey, Sayori, that’s too much to drink!"
"Well, after I dashed to the convenience store, I started sweating too! I just bought whatever I wanted to drink!"
"Geez, you really don’t know how to hold back, do you?"
Karla and Sayori laughed together, clearly enjoying themselves.
"Just don’t drink inside the garage."
"「Okay!」"
Both of them replied in unison.
It was clear that Karla was a good friend of Sayori’s.
After a quick hydration break, I began to paint Sayori’s nails the same way I had done Karla’s.
Compared to Karla’s twenty nails, I only needed half the amount for Sayori. Plus, I was already accustomed to it since I had painted her nails several times.
I finished painting Sayori’s nails smoothly.
Sayori let out a strange sound as she looked at her nails, which sparkled like a starry sky.
"How is it? How is it? Am I looking good?"
"You look great, really great."
"Let’s take a photo! Karla, get in here!"
"Okay!"
While I was cleaning up the tools, the two girls started a photo session, showing off their matching nails.
Karla hugged Sayori from behind with her four arms, showcasing her nails in the process.
As expected of a model, even in off-shots, they seemed to have a keen eye for detail.
"Azuma-kun, are you going to join us for a photo!?"
"I’m not."
"Immediate rejection! That’s hilarious! Come on!"
"That’s absolutely impossible…"
How could someone like me, a wallflower, mix in with two sparkling gal models?
Not wanting to be scolded by their fans, I firmly refused.
(I used a lot of tools…)
The brushes I used for nail polish couldn’t be used for plastic models due to the different properties of the paint.
I needed to prepare separate stocks for model use and nail use.
I also needed thinner and cleaning remover for the paint. While nail art is a relatively easy hobby, going pro requires a lot of necessary tools.
"Oh, by the way, Azuma-kun."
As Karla was absorbed in taking photos, she turned to me.
"How much do I owe you for today?"
"Owe? …What do you mean?"
"What do you mean…"
Karla looked puzzled as she took out her wallet.
"Since I got my nails done, there are material costs and service fees, right?"
"Oh, you mean the nail fee? It’s fine, you can have it for free."
"Eh?"
Karla froze.
"No, no, no, there’s no way I can accept that quality for free!"
"But I didn’t take anything from Sayori either…"
"Sayori!? You got all this done for free!?"
Karla began to skillfully tug at Sayori’s cheek with her four arms.
"Ouch, ouch, no, no, Karla!"
"What’s wrong with that?"
"It’s not that I didn’t intend to pay! I was just going to ask how much it would cost later!"
"Ah, so you forgot about it. What are we going to do? You’re practically working for free!"
"I’ll pay you right now!"
Sayori’s eyes were watery as she was pinched from all sides.
"Um—really, it’s fine. My nail skills are still very amateur, and I’m not at a level where I can charge—"
"No way! There’s no way you can do all this for free!"
"That’s right, Azuma-kun! You’re already at a level where you can charge!"
Karla chimed in, with Sayori following suit.
In reality, I wasn’t really in need of money. After delivering a few plastic model commissions through the internet, I could easily cover the cost of nail materials.
"Really, don’t worry about it. I’m doing this because I enjoy it."
"But…!"
Sayori looked concerned.
I was surprised to find myself naturally saying I enjoyed it.
Do I really like nail art?
I had started at Sayori’s request.
Just a moment ago, I felt a sense of duty to do my best for Sayori and Karla during the shoot.
But.
Somewhere along the line, I had unconsciously started to enjoy nail art. I could admit that, but—unlike plastic models, it felt different from a pure hobby.
(Huh…?)
Had nail art somehow become a hobby I liked just as much as plastic models?
Is that why I instinctively answered that I didn’t need money? I had started because I wanted to meet expectations.
(Why am I—)
Why was I so engrossed in nail art?
"Well, if that’s the case…"
Karla approached me with a mischievous smile.
"I’ll do anything to repay you, except for money."
"I’ll do it too! I’ll do anything I can! Just let me know! Anything!"
"Sayori, if you say anything too much, it sounds suggestive!"
"You said it first!"
They were chattering away. This is what it’s like when girls gather.
The atmosphere of the garage, where I used to build models alone, was completely gone. But maybe that wasn’t so bad.
"Anyway, I’ll think about the money later, but—since it’s already getting dark, we should head home."
"Eh!? What about the pedicure!?"
"That’s not possible today. Come back tomorrow."
Sayori frowned in disappointment, but I knew my concentration had its limits.
I felt bad, but I didn’t have the confidence to continue working today.
"Aw, that’s too bad. Well, it can’t be helped. See you tomorrow!"
"Ah, yeah."
I felt a bit anxious that she might come in a swimsuit again tomorrow, but well, Karla would be with her, so it should be fine.
"By the way, I’ll contact you again about the shooting time!"
"Wait, we’re going together, right—"
The swimsuit shoot was already this weekend.
I had to make sure I had all the necessary nail supplies ready. I couldn’t imagine what the shooting location would be like.
"I’m really looking forward to the shoot! Shooting with Karla!"
"Matching nails, showing off our friendship, it’s going to be great!"
"Yeah, I’m really excited!"
It seemed that nail art really did influence motivation.
As I watched the two girls getting all hyped up—
(Am I really allowed to go to a professional setting as an amateur…?)
I was worried about that.
I was only going because they called me. There was no point in worrying about it.
"Oh, by the way, Azuma-kun."
"Yes?"
"Can I post the photo we took with Karla on SNS?"
"Ah, sure."
Now that I thought about it, we had taken a two-shot.
"Since it’s for work promotion, I’d appreciate it if you could let me use it."
So professionals have to promote themselves too. That sounds tough.
"Well, that’s fine. As long as you don’t mention the garage’s location."
"Okay! I definitely won’t say it. If word gets out that kids come here for nails, that would be bad!"
"Then it’s settled."
As long as those precautions were taken, it should be fine.
"Alright, Azuma-kun, tomorrow we’ll do the pedicure, and this weekend we have the shoot!"
"Okay, okay."
"See you tomorrow!"
The two of them left the garage noisily, with Karla waving goodbye with her double arms.
Since Sayori came, every day has been busy. I had more and more to do, and I was meeting more acquaintances like Karla.
Having a lot to do wasn’t a burden. If it made Sayori and Karla happy, I wanted to do as much as I could for them.
But this was still—
(I’m doing this because I like it—not really)
Was it just a sense of duty?
Was I just getting carried away because I was making two beautiful girls happy?
As I pondered that for a moment—and realized it was pointless—I returned to cleaning up the tools.
—At this time, I was surely still caught up in the excitement, purely enjoying being asked to do various things.
I had underestimated the influence of the models.
